findings.body: Changing the loop condition from `i < items.length` to `i <= items.length` causes an extra iteration at `i === items.length`. Accessing `items[items.length]` evaluates to `undefined`, and `total += undefined` turns `total` into `NaN`.
findings.recommendation: Revert the loop boundary condition to `i < items.length`.
findings.title: Off-by-one error in loop condition produces NaN
